# Kutch Business

> Kutch Business (https://www.kutchbusiness.com) is a local job portal for Kutch, Gujarat, India. Job seekers browse and apply for local vacancies; employers post jobs and are notified instantly.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.kutchbusiness.com/): overview, popular searches, FAQs
- [Browse jobs](https://www.kutchbusiness.com/jobs): latest approved job openings with salary, timings, qualification and vacancies
- [Post a job](https://www.kutchbusiness.com/post-job): employer form to list a vacancy
- [Register](https://www.kutchbusiness.com/register): candidate registration
- [Jobs in Bhuj](https://www.kutchbusiness.com/jobs-in/bhuj)
- [Jobs in Gandhidham](https://www.kutchbusiness.com/jobs-in/gandhidham)
- [Jobs in Anjar](https://www.kutchbusiness.com/jobs-in/anjar)
- [Jobs in Mundra](https://www.kutchbusiness.com/jobs-in/mundra)

## Facts
- Coverage: Kutch district (Bhuj, Gandhidham, Adipur, Anjar, Mundra, Mandvi, Bhachau, Rapar) and nearby locations
- Each job page includes: position, company, location, salary range, experience, qualification, vacancies, timings and interview contact
- Contact: WhatsApp +91 87802 54591, email kutchbusiness1@gmail.com
- Full machine-readable index of pages: https://www.kutchbusiness.com/sitemap.xml
